# archestra_cost_export (Resource)

Scheduled export of LLM cost data as FOCUS CSV files to an `archestra_blob_provider` (API 1.5.0-rc.30 or later). The platform writes a file per completed period; run state (last run, errors, retries) stays in the UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_blob_provider" "finops" {
  name = "FinOps exports"

  s3 = {
    bucket      = "acme-finops"
    region      = "us-east-1"
    auth_method = "default_chain"
  }
}

# Daily FOCUS CSV files of LLM spend, backfilled from the start of the year.
resource "archestra_cost_export" "daily" {
  name             = "Daily LLM spend"
  blob_provider_id = archestra_blob_provider.finops.id
  schedule         = "daily"
  path_prefix      = "llm-costs"
  start_from       = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blob_provider_id` (String) UUID of the `archestra_blob_provider` the files are written to.
- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether scheduled runs write files. Disable to pause the export.
- `format` (String) File format. Only `focus_csv` today.
- `path_prefix` (String) Key prefix for the export's files, under the blob provider's own prefix, without leading or trailing `/`.
- `schedule` (String) How often a file is written: `hourly` or `daily`.
- `start_from` (String) RFC 3339 UTC time (ending in `Z`) to export usage from, including the past (a backfill). Defaults to now. Applies at creation only: changing it replaces the export. An imported export records the configured value without replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Cost export UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing cost export by UUID. start_from is not returned by the API;
# setting it after import records the value without replacing the export.
terraform import archestra_cost_export.daily 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
